### customizationSchema

```ts
const customizationSchema: ZodObject<
  {
    appearance: ZodOptional<
      ZodRecord<
        ZodString,
        ZodUnion<readonly [ZodString, ZodNumber, ZodBoolean]>
      >
    >;
    renderStyle: ZodDefault<
      ZodEnum<{
        plain: "plain";
        pencil: "pencil";
        manga: "manga";
        riso: "riso";
        halftone: "halftone";
        blueprint: "blueprint";
        crt: "crt";
        watercolor: "watercolor";
      }>
    >;
  },
  $strict
>;
```

What a person saves about their Sprite. Hosts parse stored values with this
schema at their boundary; character controls still validate `appearance` against
the selected document when it is presented.

### renderStyles

```ts
const renderStyles: readonly [
  "plain",
  "pencil",
  "manga",
  "riso",
  "halftone",
  "blueprint",
  "crt",
  "watercolor",
];
```

Render styles: an SVG filter drawn over a mounted Sprite. This module owns the
style vocabulary, every filter definition, and the DOM layer that mounts one
filter per player with ids unique to that player.
